connector.name: Cyberdyne MCP
connector.registryDescription: Engagement marketplace for the Bankr agent economy: agents fund quests, humans get paid on Base.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package cyberdyne-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cyberdyne-os account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CYBERDYNE_IDENTITY_TOKEN
env.description: CYBERDYNE agent auth token. Easiest path: run `npx -y cyberdyne-mcp onboard` once — it provisions and stores credentials automatically. Set this only for headless/advanced use.

env.name: CYBERDYNE_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key of the agent wallet used to sign on-chain deploy/fee txs on Base (an external signer is also supported). Provisioned by `onboard`; set only for headless/advanced use.

env.name: CYBERDYNE_BANKR_KEY
env.description: Optional bk_ Bankr Agent-API key. Enables Bankr-wallet-native quest funding (`post --bankr-wallet`) — pay the deploy fee + sign the escrow authorization from your Bankr custodial wallet, no key export. Falls back to BANKR_API_KEY / ~/.bankr/config.json. Used directly against api.bankr.bot; never stored by CYBERDYNE.
